name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the model for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached through the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagents at agent.spawn and, opt-in, the main loop at turn.step, falling back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with none set the engine's built-in classifier is used instead

baseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway evaluation API

modelId.title: Decision model id
modelId.description: The evaluation model the Gateway routes to

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Model alias or id for mechanical, local tasks

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier
balancedModel.description: Model alias or id for ordinary engineering work

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Model alias or id for hard or high-stakes work

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Below this the session's own model is kept; the Gateway reports a distribution, not a confidence, so this reads its highest probability

routeSubagents.title: Route subagents
routeSubagents.description: Pick the model for each subagent at agent.spawn

routeMainLoop.title: Route the main loop
routeMainLoop.description: Pick the model for the main conversation too; off by default because switching models mid-session invalidates the prompt cache

pinModelFloor.title: Never downgrade
pinModelFloor.description: Never route below the model the session is already on; only upgrades are applied

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a decision before letting the request through unchanged

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each routing decision to the session log
